far:
Refine the supplied approved winter-station layer toward the visual principles of Hollow Knight: Silksong environment art while retaining this original railway setting. Treat this as a careful 2D illustrated art-direction pass: bolder readable silhouette groups, controlled hand-inked contours, sparse hand-placed directional dry-brush marks, broad cool blue-teal-gray shadow shapes, soft painted atmospheric washes, selective edges, dramatically localized warm amber accents. Eliminate generic semi-photoreal game-background rendering, continuous bevels, all-over concrete noise, airbrushed shiny materials and equally sharp detail everywhere. The scene should feel more authored and quietly mysterious. More graphic shape design and restrained confident drawing, not merely darker exposure. Maintain exactly the same approved composition, proportions, full 1659x948 wide 7:4 canvas, camera, registration and object locations. Do not introduce fantasy insects, silk motifs, vegetation, words, characters or unrelated props. Work ONLY on the given layer; never invent or flatten the other scene layers. One layer output, no border or contact sheet. Important: preserve the full canvas, do not crop to object bounds.
Layer-specific instructions: FAR only, fully opaque. Keep viaduct at exactly y=47..60% and city mass below it as registered. Change pale daytime sky to a restrained dusk atmosphere: quiet desaturated slate-blue upper sky, a broad luminous pale cyan-gray mist band around the horizon, medium-light fog below. Make cloud shapes broad sweeping hand-painted washes, remove almost all small cloud texture. The distant bridge should have a clear elegant hand-drawn line silhouette fading into fog, its truss simplified to a few legible rhythms, and city contours barely visible. Use 3 distinct atmospheric depth planes with delicate softer distant edges. Mood serene and eerie, illuminated fog remains bright enough for combat silhouette readability. No hard black outlines on distant objects. No foreground or floor.
